title: Add inline // keepAlive: justification comments to auth_providers.dart's two singleton providers
why: SM-6 requires every keepAlive: true to carry an inline `// keepAlive:` justification comment, specifically because the planned [Pending] audit grep keys off that literal tag beside the annotation (docs/coding-standards.md:156). Both providers here only have an ordinary doc comment above the function ('Provides the singleton ... used app-wide'), not the tagged comment the future checker looks for — when that grep ships, these two will false-positive as unjustified even though the reasoning is already documented in prose. (The same gap recurs at other keepAlive sites repo-wide, e.g. content_index.dart, registry_provider.dart, preference_providers.dart — those are outside this batch, noted here only for the orchestrator's dedup.)
recommendation: Add a one-line `// keepAlive: <reason>` comment immediately above each @Riverpod(keepAlive: true), e.g. '// keepAlive: stateless singleton facade, cheap to keep for app lifetime'.
acceptance_criteria: Both providers carry a `// keepAlive:` tagged comment.
Future SM-6 audit grep (once shipped) passes for this file.

corrections: SM-6's 'why' paragraph illustrates the requirement only via family-leak scenarios, so applying the comment mandate to non-family singleton providers is a plausible but not airtight reading of the rule; worth flagging as interpretive.
